pages.name: Logo
pages.description: One system, three companies. Codemasters is the parent of Sembuh AI and Flipmaster; company materials carry their own logo with "Powered by Codemasters" underneath.

pages.name: Colors
pages.description: Thirteen colour families of 11 steps each. Every colour on screen is one of these tokens, never a free-picked hex.

pages.name: Typography
pages.description: One typeface, Timeless Grotesk, on an 11-step scale from Display 2xl to Text xs. Every text uses a style from the scale; never set a size or line height by hand.

pages.name: Icons
pages.description: Feather-style outline icons on a 24 grid, in four sizes. Icons take the colour of their text, so one file serves every state.

pages.name: Shadows & Blur
pages.description: Seven shadows and four background blurs that put elements on the z-axis. The higher the layer, the bigger the shadow.

pages.name: Grids & Spacing
pages.description: A 4 px soft grid: a fixed spacing scale, four containers, column grids for desktop, tablet and mobile, and the radius set.

pages.name: Avatar
pages.description: A person or a company, shown as a photo, initials or a placeholder icon. Comes alone, in an overlapping group, or with a name and a secondary line.

pages.name: Badge
pages.description: A small, non-interactive label for a status, category or count. Status pills, claim type tags, AI confidence and filter chips are all badges.

pages.name: Banner
pages.description: A message about a page, a card or a form in one of four roles: info, success, warning and error. Inline inside the content, or as a full-width strip under the header bar.

pages.name: Button
pages.description: Runs an action on the current page: save, submit, open a dialog, start an analysis. Seven hierarchies tell the user which action matters most.

pages.name: Button group
pages.description: A row of joined buttons for related, equal-weight choices: a view switch (Hari, Minggu, Bulan), pagination arrows or a small set of tools.

pages.name: Card
pages.description: The container for one topic on a page: a claim summary, a table, a chart, a metric. White, bordered, radius 12. Includes the inner card, the AI summary card, metric cards and link cards.

pages.name: Chart
pages.description: Bar, line, stacked bar and donut charts in plain SVG: a validated series order, thin marks, legend, tooltip and a table view. For one number, use the Card metric instead.

pages.name: Checkbox and radio
pages.description: One component for three selection controls, picked with Type: Checkbox for any number of options, Radio for exactly one, and Check circle for selectable cards and rows.

pages.name: Checkbox group
pages.description: Selectable cards: a list of bordered cards where the whole card is the control. Use it when each option needs a description or a visual, such as a plan, a payment method or an assignee.

pages.name: Combobox
pages.description: Type to find people or values and pick one or many. Picks show as chips, results can come from the server while you type, and a value that does not exist yet can be added.

pages.name: Date picker
pages.description: A date field people can type into or pick from a calendar: one date (one month, picks and closes) or a range (two months, quick ranges, Batal and Terapkan). Monday first, dd/mm/yyyy.

pages.name: Dropdown menu
pages.description: An action menu opened from a button, a row-actions icon or the account avatar. For choosing a value in a form, use Input dropdown.

pages.name: File upload
pages.description: Adds documents to a claim: a drop zone people click or drag files onto, and a row per file with its progress, then done, failed or refused. One file or many, image thumbnails, and a checklist of the documents a claim needs.

pages.name: Filter bar
pages.description: The controls above a list that narrow it down: status tabs with counts, search, filter menus, a period and the active filters as chips. Filters apply as soon as they change. On narrow screens the filters move into a sheet.

pages.name: Header bar
pages.description: The top of every app page: the page title, or a breadcrumb on detail pages, on the left and the page actions on the right. Sticky, white, 80 high. Optional search and notifications.

pages.name: Input dropdown
pages.description: A select field: pick one value for a form field or a filter. For running an action from a button, use Dropdown menu.

pages.name: Input field
pages.description: A single-line text field with a label above, an optional hint below, and an error state that says what is wrong and how to fix it.

pages.name: Loading
pages.description: What people see while data or an action is on its way: skeletons in the shape of the content, a spinner for waits of unknown length, and which to use when (with Button loading, Progress and Toast).

pages.name: Modal
pages.description: A dialog that stops the page for one decision or one short form: confirmations, a destructive check, sending a claim. Native <dialog>, so focus, Esc and the inert page come from the browser.

pages.name: Pagination
pages.description: The footer of a long list: how many rows per page, which rows are shown out of how many, and two arrows to the previous and next page. One row, right-aligned under the table.

pages.name: Progress bar and circle
pages.description: Shows how far a measurable task or value has got: an upload, AI analysis steps, quota used. For work of unknown length use a spinner instead.

pages.name: Sidebar
pages.description: The app's main navigation: a fixed gray-900 column on the left with grouped menu items, count badges, sub-menus and the account menu. Collapses from 280 to 72 with icons and tooltips.

pages.name: Slider
pages.description: Picks a value or a range by dragging, when the position matters more than the exact number: a confidence threshold, an amount range.

pages.name: Social button
pages.description: Signs the user in with an account on another platform. For third-party sign-in only.

pages.name: Table
pages.description: Rows of records: claims, invoice items, members. A gray-50 header band, gray-200 row dividers, right-aligned tabular numbers, status pills, sortable columns, row selection, grouped rows and nested rows that fold.

pages.name: Tabs
pages.description: Switch between panels of content in one place: the sections of a claim, the views of a card or the parts of a settings page. Four types: Folder, Underline, Segmented and Vertical.

pages.name: Textarea input field
pages.description: Multi-line text: notes, rejection reasons, AI summary edits. Same label, hint and error as Input field, plus an optional character counter.

pages.name: Toast
pages.description: Short feedback after an action that closes itself: a white card with a status icon and a timer bar. The react-toastify API (toast.success, toast.error, toast.loading + toast.update, toast.promise) in plain JS.

pages.name: Toggle
pages.description: An on/off switch whose change takes effect immediately, such as "Tampilkan hanya klaim saya" or a notification setting. If the choice is applied only after Save, use a Checkbox.

pages.name: Tooltip and help icon
pages.description: A small label that appears on hover or keyboard focus to explain an element or show text that was cut off. The help icon is the standard trigger after a label or inside an input.

pages.name: Verification code
pages.description: One large box per digit, for OTP and verification codes only. Also called Mega input field.

pages.name: WYSIWYG editor
pages.description: Rich-text formatting for long text a user writes or edits: the AI summary ("Edit Ringkasan") and advisor notes. Use a plain Textarea when formatting is not needed.

pages.name: Slides
pages.description: Pitch decks and presentations for Codemasters, Sembuh AI and Flipmaster: a 1920 × 1080 canvas, a 12-column grid, fixed anchors and the same tokens as the web.
